title: Equivalent circuit representation conditions
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $f$ be a Boolean function on $n$ inputs. There exists a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on those inputs, with distinct arguments at each gate, at most two arguments per gate, and exactly one argument at every NOT gate, computing $f$, if and only if there exists such a circuit computing $f$ in which every gate has exactly one argument for a NOT gate or two for an AND or OR gate and every vertex other than the output has positive fanout.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ inputs
